quarterly_data.signal: Deferred revenue year-end outlook: CFO Chantelle Breithaupt said she does not guide deferred and it can come up or down in any quarter, but 'I anticipate deferred to end at a higher balance in Q4 this year than it did Q4 last year', generally going up on the year and complementary to the P&L growth.
